## Activity

During July 2020, Market Eye Clinic completed 122 captures. This records the volume of image capture activity undertaken at the site during the month. The activity provides the basis for subsequent image-quality review and grading. Any operational issues affecting capture should continue to be recorded promptly so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate service arrangements.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 9 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.4. This indicates that a small proportion of images could not be used for grading and should remain an area of operational attention. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support investigation and follow-up.

## Grading

There were 16 referable results during the reporting period. The median grading lag was 1 day. Results should continue to be reviewed through the established grading process, with attention given to maintaining timely reporting and identifying any recurring issues that may affect image quality or grading performance.
